heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 96–465, title II, § 2205(1), Oct. 17, 1980, 94 Stat. 2159

notes.text: Section 1065, act Aug. 13, 1946, ch. 957, title VIII, § 805, as added July 12, 1976, Pub. L. 94–350, title V, § 503, 90 Stat. 835, authorized maintenance of existing areas of conformity between Civil Service and Foreign Service Retirement Systems.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Feb. 15, 1981, except as otherwise provided, see section 2403 of Pub. L. 96–465, set out as an Effective Date note under section 3901 of this title.
